name: claudetocodex
description: ClaudeToCodex - cross-session bridge between Codex and Claude Code original sessions (Windows, single pair, short text).

interface.shortDescription: Bridge work messages between Codex and a running Claude Code session.
interface.longDescription: Connect this Codex session to a running Claude Code session, then send, reply and follow up across sessions without the PO relaying text.
defaultPrompt: Connect to a running Claude session and send it a work message.
